steam.store_details: Runs on a modified Dark Engine build.
steam.patches: The unofficial 'Sneaky Upgrade' patch (works with the Steam and GOG releases) fixes a well-documented multi-core CPU issue and other modern-system quirks — worth pairing with EAX, much like TFix/T2Fix for the earlier Thief games.

gog.store_details: Runs on a modified Dark Engine build.
gog.patches: The unofficial 'Sneaky Upgrade' patch (works with the Steam and GOG releases) fixes a well-documented multi-core CPU issue and other modern-system quirks — worth pairing with EAX, much like TFix/T2Fix for the earlier Thief games.

eax.fix: EAX is off by default: in-game, open Options, scroll to the bottom, and enable 'Audio Hardware Mixing', 'EAX ADVANCED HD' and 'EAX Multiple Environments' (per Creative's setup guide for the game).
